'''Jozdit''' was a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that lived on the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. They served as a member on the [[Tribunal (Rishi)|Tribunal]]<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Sharing Our Bounty|Rishi}}</ref> in the year [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player never actually meets Jozdit in the game, rather, they only ever hear about them should the player choose to threaten [[Navolii]] during the quest "Sharing Our Bounty" on Rishi during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event storyline.<ref name="TOR" />

Should the player do this, they will get a threatening letter from Jozdit who informs them that they know about the threats made against Navolii, and that they will be keeping their eye on the Feast to make sure it is not up to anything malevolent.<ref name="TOR" />
